verdict.rationale: A skills pack for coding agents could plausibly ship a bulk-operation skill (e.g., batch triage or batch issue updates), so the axis applies. The evidence only shows per-item workflows: the triage skill moves issues through a state machine, a skill splits a spec into tickets, and grilling asks questions in one round. None of these documents performing one operation across many items at once. Installing the whole skill set is an installation feature, not a bulk-operation capability, so it earns no credit.
